stem: A small site's age and gender report hides rows and shows a thresholding notice. Which statement is correct?

options.text: Thresholds are system-defined and cannot be changed; expanding the date range or using BigQuery Export are the listed workarounds
Increasing event data retention to 14 months removes thresholds, because the older data adds enough users to each row
Thresholding means the report was sampled; choosing more detailed results in an exploration shows every hidden row
An Administrator can switch thresholds off in Admin, and the fix Google lists for small sites is to set the reporting identity to device-based
